name: Narrative Sparkline
tagline: Deep navy canvas with a single hand-drawn-feeling waveform, dotted what-is and what-could-be rails, gray history and one orange turning point (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Midnight navy with pale steel lines and a single orange highlight for the turning point

typography.style: Heavy Inter titles with Geist Mono dates and tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Telling how something changed over time, with a rising and falling line as the main visual. Suits founder stories, retrospectives and talks that need an emotional arc.
avoid_for: Reference-style decks with dense tables or many unrelated numbers.
